remainingDifferences: A local manual PhysicsScene and384-body mobile pool remain. Original instantiates all actors. Three campaign levels446,377,269 have621,584,580 initial dynamic placements, so they initialize in bounded batches.

Far stable bodies can retire when velocity is small; source collectable sleep threshold0 prevents ordinary automatic sleeping. This pooling optimization is deliberate and cannot be called bit-identical.
Support graph is a bounded approximation of original downward rigidbody queries. Source ring aperture now provides real contact support and collection uses original below-floor volume.

Twenty source convex hulls are simplified for mobile cooking, including four confirmed warning cases repaired after the first test run. Three newly enabled large collision meshes use exact convex hulls (48/29/32 vertices), without geometric simplification.
Hole activation uses a capsule footprint/ClosestPoint test and a25 activation budget per update; original uses trigger queue capped25 actions per frame. Material-volume overlap uses collider bounds.
Physics outcomes cannot be promised bit-identical across Unity/PhysX versions, CPU architectures and frame timing. Remoteconfig and prior original PlayerPrefs states are unavailable.

stage3TraceVerification.conclusion: Continuous physical progress. The prior 40-second sweep deadline was too short for the recovered below-floor collection trigger; no gameplay physics change was warranted.

stage7TraceVerification.result: Passed in prior full sweep after test-input projection fix; final frozen-planner sweep pending
stage7TraceVerification.diagnosis: Two tennis-ball pivots were outside the legal hole-center area. A reachable adjacent catch position preserved source fit and caught them. The test planner had incorrectly required the item pivot itself to be reachable.

stage9TraceVerification.diagnosis: The long basket needed one support edge exposed long enough for gravity to tip it. Rotated compact burgers also had collision centers offset from root pivots. Correcting test aims to active collision bounds, using long probes only for wide objects, and exploring other targets after a failed probe resolved the artificial planner stalls.

campaignVerificationLimitations.status: Final bounded suite completed; see finalRegression/finalCampaign for exact unresolved cases
campaignVerificationLimitations.input: Automated test-only teleport positions, including reachable small probes and support-edge probes. Does not alter actors, contacts, gravity, forces, fit gates or collection.
campaignVerificationLimitations.clock: Time.timeScale=4 with original fixed simulation step0.02; source timers informational for this geometry reachability test.

watchdogs.progressMeans: Collection, first occurrence of a target/probe pair since last collection, or genuine downward velocity of the current falling target. Repeated static attempts do not reset the clock.

campaignVerificationLimitations.notProven: Human completion times, difficulty balance, device performance and all465 main stages are not proven by a30-stage automated sweep.

rotatedFloorMembershipCorrection.fix: Inverse authored TRS to model local XZ bounds; retain transformed world AABB for coarse arena limits. All source floor transforms are yaw-only.
